Ben / Karthik —

Quick finance take:
- Discount bands (guidance): 3yr commit -> up to 12% off list depending on spend band; 5yr commit -> up to 18% off list for larger commits. For mid-tier customers with steady ramp we typically offer 8–12% (3yr) and 12–18% (5yr).
- Staged invoicing: Acceptable. For prepay we prefer to issue a single proforma for the committed amount and then schedule invoicing in 4x installments per fiscal year (1/4 each quarter). Recognize that prepay means funds received in advance; if they require net-30 invoicing we can do an invoice schedule but need to mirror revenue recognition rules.
- PO / billing details: Procurement will need legal entity name, address, tax id (W-9) and a line-item proforma. I attached a draft proforma stub we can use.
- Accounting ask: If Aurelia wants a multi-year split with partial payments (not full prepay), we should treat that as an installment arrangement — provide payment schedule and indicate where credits/shortfalls are reconciled at annual true-up.

I attached proforma_invoice_aurelia_Q4-2026.xlsx with placeholder legal details; if they confirm entity and PO timeline we'll finalize.
